plugins.description: Classifies each prompt in one API call and injects a one-line routing hint, plus a CLI and skill for offloading snap decisions — and on compaction, a batched keep-or-drop judgment per transcript block that survives verbatim. Shaped by an eval over 1,613 real prompts; see eval/.
